reasons: Claimed status is 'compliant', and consistent with that no redline or comment is proposed — the rendered paragraphs are identical to the originals.

Cited text supports compliance: Section 4.1/4.2 and Exhibit B payment terms impose only ordinary license, maintenance and revenue-share fees; Section 11 (Term/Termination/Effect of Termination) contains no early-termination fee, minimum payment, acceleration, penalty or stipulated-damages obligation on Corio (the Customer).

Post-termination payments in 11.3 relate to continued use of the Software by existing Customers (value received), not liquidated damages, so the preferred position (no Customer-payable LDs or penalties) is satisfied.
Party direction is correctly identified — Corio is our client/licensee and Commerce One the licensor/host — so the rule's 'flag only when Customer pays' condition is properly applied.
No deterministic check failures; finding is appropriate to retain as internal evaluation evidence rather than a negotiation issue.
